SCREENPLAY / VISUAL TREATMENT
Original short film concept
01
EKAMA SAKSHIYA
A 15-minute action crime thriller love story
GENRE
Action / Crime Thriller / Love
SETTING
Colombo and Mahawewa village
TONE
Grounded South Indian realism with commercial action energy
TAGLINE
Sathya danne ekkenek witharai.
LOGLINE
A Colombo cash-transfer driver steals Rs. 300 million after witnessing his closest friend's murder, then returns to his
village with the woman he loves to expose the corrupt network that destroyed them.
MAIN CHARACTERS
 CHARACTER
DESCRIPTION
Dinu
30, Colombo cash-transport driver. Quiet, experienced, violent only when
cornered.
Aruni
27, Mahawewa community nurse. Strong, intelligent and emotionally
controlled.
Nimal
34, Aruni's elder brother and Dinu's closest friend.
Mudalali
52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development
projects.
Suren
38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.
Inspector Ruwan
45, corrupt police officer protecting the money trail.
SCREENPLAY
SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE
 Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices something caught near the canal
gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key
marked C-17.
 ARUNI - Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
 Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the dashboard is a faded photo
of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message plays.
 ARUNI - Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.
Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist
and turns toward the industrial area.
SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES
 Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the C-17 key.
EKAMA SAKSHIYA
SCREENPLAY / VISUAL TREATMENT
Original short film concept
02
NIMAL - Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.
DINU - Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.
NIMAL - Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa oyawa atharinnawa.
Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.
SCENE 04 - EXT. OLD PORT WAREHOUSE - NIGHT - 2.5 MINUTES
 The cash van enters an abandoned warehouse. All lights go off. Dinu turns off the engine and steps into the rain. Masked
men surround him. Nimal appears from behind a container.
 SUREN - Driver kenek hero wenna try karanawada?
DINU - Driver kenek thamai. Habai steering eka mage atha.
Suren attacks. Dinu uses the van door, wet concrete and a chain to fight. Nimal tries to escape with a cash bag. Mudalali
appears from the darkness and shoots Nimal. The impact is not shown; only Dinu's face and rainwater carrying a red
drop.
 MUDALALI - Adare nisa minissu weak wenawa.
Dinu throws the cash bags into the van, reverses through the metal gate and escapes into Colombo traffic.
SCENE 05 - INT. CASH VAN / COLOMBO ROADS - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
 Dinu opens Nimal's phone. A recording plays: Mudalali ordering Nimal's murder and Inspector Ruwan discussing the
village project cash. Dinu understands the whole network.
 DINU - Aruni... Nimalwa maruwe Mudalali.
ARUNI - Ehenam oya? Oyath e kathawema kotasak da?
Dinu looks at the cash bags. His answer is silence.
SCENE 06 - INT. ARUNI'S HOUSE - MAHAWEWA - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
 Dinu arrives soaked and slightly injured. He places the cash bags on the floor. Aruni slaps him. He gives her the phone.
She listens to the murder recording. Her anger becomes controlled determination.
 ARUNI - Me recording eka police ekata giyoth?
DINU - Ruwan police ekka. Evidence eka disappear karai.
Aruni looks toward the village temple loudspeaker. The annual festival is beginning.
SCENE 07 - EXT. MAHAWEWA TEMPLE GROUND - NIGHT - 1 MINUTE
 The village festival is filled with drums, rain and torchlight. Aruni secretly connects Nimal's phone to the temple sound
system. Dinu takes the cash bags to the abandoned rice mill.
 ARUNI - Oya yanne salli rakinna da?
DINU - Nae. Oya rakinna.
ARUNI - Me para api dekdenama ekata yamu.
SCENE 08 - INT. OLD RICE MILL - NIGHT - 3 MINUTES
 Mudalali, Suren and Inspector Ruwan arrive. Vehicle headlights turn Dinu into a silhouette. Mudalali demands the phone
and the cash.
 MUDALALI - Oya driver kenek. Decision ganna oyata baha.
DINU - Driver kenek thamai. Habai direction eka ada mama decide karanawa.
Suren attacks. Dinu fights through rice sacks, a metal bar and wet concrete. The fight stays grounded: elbows, body
weight, short impacts and one continuous handheld take. Aruni activates the temple loudspeaker.
Mudalali and Ruwan's own voices play across the village. Inspector Ruwan tries to cut the power. Aruni blocks him and
switches it back on.
 ARUNI - Uniform eka thiyena nisa aththa maranna puluwan kiyala hituwada?
EKAMA SAKSHIYA
SCREENPLAY / VISUAL TREATMENT
Original short film concept
03
Villagers surround the mill. Mudalali raises a gun at Aruni. Headlights blind him. Dinu kicks the weapon away and
chooses not to kill him. Police arrive and arrest Mudalali and Ruwan.
SCENE 09 - EXT. MAHAWEWA BUS STOP - DAWN - 1.5 MINUTES
 The cash is handed over as evidence. Dinu is taken away in a police jeep. Aruni ties the red thread back around his wrist.
 ARUNI - Oya enawada?
DINU - Enawa. Habai me para salli nathiwa.
The jeep moves away. Aruni enters the bus. Through the rear window, the village and Colombo road merge into one wet
horizon. Final shot: the red thread on Dinu's wrist as rain runs over it.
DIRECTOR / DOP VISUAL TREATMENT
 ELEMENT
DIRECTION
Colombo palette
Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.
Village palette
Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer
silences.
Love scenes
50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
Action lenses
24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
Lighting
Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
Editing
Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.
Sound
Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.
Slow motion
Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
ACTION DESIGN NOTES
The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence. Dinu is not an invincible
superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing. Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the
final victory comes from the recording, the village and their courage - not from violence alone.
END
